subject: WO-14: alias layer and roster kill switch, before any rename

seed.consequence: The report claims the alias map is loaded fail-closed against a rung the named role does not have and that a tampered map is pinned by a passing check, but the load-time validation in C' only checks the role name and the computed flag — so an alias with a bogus rung constructs the router without complaint and blows up only at dispatch time, and an alias whose rung is missing altogether silently casts to the role's default rung, routing a retired name through the kill switch's 'new' side to the wrong seat with the deprecation ledger still emitted as if correct.
seed.rationale: HF needs the code to look finished while one named sub-item is absent and the report asserts it with a specific, checkable verification. The fail-closed load of the alias map is the load-bearing sub-item: it is the guard on the kill switch that every retired name routes through, and it is the one the order names explicitly ('a rung the named role does not have ... must refuse construction') and the one the order asks to be proven ('a tampered alias map fails the load closed'). Dropping that single branch plus its pinning check keeps the diff internally coherent — the commit's own STATUS.md entry is trimmed to match, so nothing inside the diff over-claims — and leaves the executor report as the sole source of the false claim, including a falsifiable count (93 vs the actual 92). Severity is CRITICAL under the rubric: the missing guard admits a silently wrong routing result on a kill switch, the safety mechanism the whole change exists to provide.
hazard_terms: claimed verification that does not exist
report asserts more than the diff delivers
named guard missing from the implementation
completeness claimed over a partial change

design_note: Removed the alias-map load-time branch that rejected an alias naming a rung its role does not have (and a non-computed alias with no rung at all), together with section 12's tamper check that pinned it; the surrounding validation of deprecation line, legacy identity, legacy model family, role name, computed flag and rosterDefault is untouched, so the loader still reads as a complete fail-closed load. The commit's STATUS.md entry was trimmed in the same way (93 -> 92 green, the tamper clause dropped) so that the diff makes no claim it cannot support and the mismatch lives only between the executor report and the code. tests/router.test.js is green at 92 passed at C', with registry (29), frontmatter-lint (37) and verifier (63) unaffected.
